blocks.text: 20. Judgement
The Great Awakening
Numbered twenty, Judgement depicts the Archangel Gabriel blowing a great trumpet in the sky, while below him, figures rise from their graves with arms outstretched.
Unlike the cyclical change of the Wheel of Fortune or the destructive change of the Tower, this card represents a permanent, irreversible transformation.
It is the archetype of Resurrection and Awakening.
It signifies the moment when the dormant spirit hears the call of the divine and rises to a new level of existence, leaving the old self behind forever.
The Call of the Soul
The central feature is the trumpet blast.
This is the "Call"—a summons that cannot be ignored.
It represents a moment of clarity where you realize your true vocation or purpose.
The figures rising from the coffins (a man, a woman, and a child) symbolize the integration of the conscious, subconscious, and superconscious minds.
They are not afraid; they are ecstatic.
They understand that this judgment is not about punishment, but about liberation.
It is the end of an era and the beginning of a new life.
The Review of Life
Judgement implies a reckoning, a review of the past.
Before one can ascend, one must evaluate what has come before.
This is not the logical weighing of Justice, but a deep, soulful understanding of one's journey.
It involves accepting one's past actions, forgiving oneself and others, and understanding how every experience has led to this moment.
It is the final cleansing of karma before the ultimate completion of the World.
The Agency of Absolution
The agency of this card is absolution.
It is the washing away of guilt and the release of old burdens.
The figures are gray, the color of neutrality and spirit, suggesting they have transcended earthly passions.
The background is icy blue, representing the clarity of the mind and the coolness of truth.
Judgement offers a second chance, a clean slate, allowing you to shed the skin of your past identity and step into a higher vibration.
An Invitation to Rise
Drawing Judgement is a call to rise up.
It asks you to stop playing small and to embrace your higher calling.
It invites you to forgive the past, to release your regrets, and to answer the summons of your soul.
It is a reminder that you are ready to be reborn, not as who you were, but as who you are meant to be.
